title: Diver sucked into a giant grouper's mouth

tellings.quote: curious so it came up behind him and it opened its mouth and he got sucked backwards into this fish mouth

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle passes on a story he was told about a diver working at an oil platform in the Gulf of Mexico, in the 1960s or earlier. According to the story, a giant grouper, a huge fish, got curious, came up behind the diver, opened its mouth, and sucked him in backwards.
